caption: Sundial Mesa Residents Association v. Caldera Compression & Cooling Inc.
synopsis: Residents of Sundial Mesa suspect that hexavalent chromium from Caldera's cooling and compressor facility reached their wells. Counsel must preserve records, build a defensible sampling and hydrological chain, distinguish exposure from individual medical causation, protect filing deadlines, and keep an adverse judgment open for appeal before explicitly closing the matter.
legal_issues: defensible sampling and chain of custody
facility use, disposal records, and corporate notice
exposure chronology versus individual medical causation
preservation, limitation, claim-filing, and appeal deadlines
first-instance judgment, appellate remedy, and explicit closure
